title: Hailey Bieber said 'optimistical delusion' helped her build Rhode into $1 billion brand
summary: Rhode founder Hailey Bieber revealed how ‘optimistical delusion’ helped her set a $1 billion price tag for her beauty brand during an interview at The New York Times' DealBook Summit
